objective: Disenar, sin ejecutar, la UAT controlada de Gate12N para el flujo Persona-Link usando exclusivamente el candidato ya certificado: usuario Nestor Oxte / noxte@alpyc.com, UnidadNegocioID 19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C (130MID), Empresa corporativa int 5 solo como metadata, SocioID 62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58 (SOC-00001, Carlos Alberto Mendoza), PersonaID NULL. La salida debe certificar el plan ejecutable por pasos con PRECHECK, ACCION_UAT, ASSERTS, ROLLBACK_CLEANUP y POSTCHECK. No ejecutar ninguna mutacion ni UAT en este job.

queries.name: uat_precheck_candidate_exact
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,NombreCompleto,Estatus,Activo,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: uat_precheck_user_context
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) u.UsuarioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),u.PublicUUID) AS PublicUUID,u.Email,u.NombreCompleto,CONVERT(varchar(36),urc.UnidadNegocioID) AS UnidadNegocioID,urc.EmpresaID,urc.RolID FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc ON urc.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID AND urc.Activo=1 WHERE u.Activo=1 AND u.Email=N'noxte@alpyc.com' AND urc.UnidadNegocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: uat_precheck_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT m.CodigoModulo,a.CodigoAccion,prm.Permitido,prm.Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc ON urc.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID AND urc.Activo=1 INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm ON prm.RolID=urc.RolID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m ON m.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID WHERE u.Email=N'noxte@alpyc.com' AND urc.UnidadNegocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C') AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CodigoModulo)))=N'cava_socios' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.CodigoAccion))) IN (N'VER',N'EDITAR') AND prm.Permitido=1 AND prm.Activo=1;

queries.name: uat_precheck_persona_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona) AS total_personas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo) AS total_vinculos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE PersonaID IS NOT NULL) AS socios_vinculados;

queries.name: uat_precheck_fk_integrity
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

constraints: Design only; do not execute UAT
Use only the certified candidate user/unit/socio
No permission menu role user unit or company changes
UAT design must include explicit PRECHECK ACTION_UAT ASSERTS ROLLBACK_CLEANUP POSTCHECK
Rollback must remove only UAT-created canonical records and restore Socio PersonaID to NULL
No Cliente link during UAT unless separately certified later
CavaSocios_Socios.EmpresaID is UnidadNegocioID UUID; Sistema_Empresas.EmpresaID INT is metadata only
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
